q1.explanationZh: 第二段说她没有大摄像机和大团队，只用了自己的手机和想法。

evidence.quote: Charli used only her phone and her own ideas.

q2.sampleAnswer: Charli saw many of her friends getting lost in their phones.

keyPoints.descZh: 看到许多朋友沉迷手机
examples: Her friends getting lost in their phones.

q2.rubricZh: 要点：看到很多朋友沉迷手机。
q2.explanationZh: 第四段说灵感来自现实生活：她看到很多朋友沉迷在手机里。

evidence.quote: I see so many of my friends getting lost in their phones

q3.sampleAnswer: It tells the story of a young woman who cannot stop looking at her phone, and a dark force slowly pulls her in as she keeps scrolling.

keyPoints.descZh: 女子沉迷手机，被黑暗力量拉入
examples: A young woman cannot stop looking at her phone and a dark force pulls her in.

q3.rubricZh: 要点：女子停不下看手机，被黑暗力量慢慢吞噬。
q3.explanationZh: 第四段直接讲了电影内容：女子一直刷手机，一股黑暗力量慢慢把她拉进去，概括这一点即可。

evidence.quote: The film tells the story of a young woman who cannot stop looking at her phone.

q4.sampleAnswer: Losing oneself in the digital world.

keyPoints.descZh: 象征沉迷手机/迷失在数字世界
examples: Losing oneself in the digital world.

q4.rubricZh: 要点：手机成瘾/沉迷虚拟世界的危险。
q4.explanationZh: 女子一直刷手机，黑暗力量把她拉进去，可以推断它象征沉迷手机、迷失在虚拟世界。

evidence.quote: a dark force slowly pulls her in

q5.sampleAnswer: Yes, I think it is a good way. Because phones are easy to get and use, and teenagers can make films anytime, anywhere without expensive equipment. It allows them to focus on storytelling and ideas, just like Charli did.

examples: Yes, I think it is a good way.
Phones are easy to get and use.

q5.rubricZh: 开放题，言之有理即可：表明观点（1分）并给出理由（1分）。
q5.explanationZh: 没有标准答案，先说出你的看法（是或不是），再给一个合理的理由，比如手机方便、便宜，或者设备不如创意重要。

evidence.quote: Charli used only her phone and her own ideas.
